shadows.name: sheet-lift

shadows.name: nav-separation

shadows.name: fab-glow

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Full-width primary action — the one blue button per view.

components.description: Neutral secondary action on the blue-grey ground.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:block; width:100%; padding:14px; border:none; border-radius:12px; background:#f0f4f8; color:#0f172a; font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'SF Pro Text',sans-serif; font-size:16px; font-weight:600; text-align:center; cursor:pointer; transition:opacity .2s ease, transform .2s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { opacity:.82; transform:scale(.99); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat white grouping container with a hairline border, no shadow.
components.css: .ds-card { background:#fff; border:1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius:14px; padding:18px; font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'SF Pro Text',sans-serif; } .ds-card-total { font-size:13px; color:#475569; } .ds-card-num { font-size:34px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:-1px; color:#0f172a; margin-top:4px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Hairline-bordered field; focus shifts the border to Ledger Blue.

narrative.overview: Family Finances looks like a calm, private book of record — hairline-ruled, written in ink, with a single blue pen reserved for the things that actually need a decision. It is a product surface, not a marketing page, optimised for a 30-second check-in: one big honest number, then the accounts beneath it, and everything denser folded away behind a tap. Depth comes from whitespace and thin rules, not shadows or colour. The palette is near-monochrome on a soft blue-grey ground with exactly one accent — blue #2563eb. Icons are quiet monochrome filled SVG using currentColor; an account is its initial in a neutral grey circle. It rejects gamified fintech, crypto-trading aggression, and the cluttered high-street bank dashboard.
keyCharacteristics: One number first; density behind a tap.
Near-monochrome + a single blue accent used on <=10% of any screen.
Flat by default — hairline borders and whitespace, not shadows.
No emoji, no per-type colours; account identity is an initial in a grey circle.
Mobile-first, capped at a 430px column that centres on desktop.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Blue #2563eb is the only accent and appears on <=10% of any screen — actions, active state, focus, links. A second accent hue is wrong.

rules.name: The No-Casino Rule
rules.body: Positive and neutral amounts render in ink, not green. Only negatives get the single restrained red, and the up/down glyph — not colour — is the primary signal.

rules.name: The Sentence-Case Rule
rules.body: Headings are sentence case at weight 600 — never uppercase, never letter-spaced eyebrows.

rules.name: The Weight Ceiling
rules.body: 700 is the heaviest weight (headers only); everything else is 600 or 400-500. No 800/900.

rules.name: The Flat-Ledger Rule
rules.body: If separation is needed, reach for a hairline border or more whitespace before a shadow. A card that isn't floating has no shadow.

dos: Do lead every screen with one honest number (Display, 30-36px/600), then a hairline-separated list.
Do keep blue #2563eb to <=10% of a screen — actions, active state, focus, links.
Do show amount direction with the up/down glyph; positives in ink, red #dc2626 for negatives and destructive actions only.
Do separate with 1px hairlines (#e2e8f0) and whitespace before considering a shadow.
Do represent an account as its initial in a 40px #eef2f6 circle, flex-centred.
Do keep icons as monochrome filled SVG using currentColor; >=44px tap targets; honor prefers-reduced-motion.
Do fold density (month-by-month tables, full transaction lists) behind a Show all toggle.
donts: Don't ship playful / gamified fintech cues — no confetti, mascots, streaks, badges, bright gradients, or emoji-as-icon.
Don't drift toward a crypto / trading app — no neon-on-black, tickers, hype, pervasive red/green, or dark-by-default.
Don't rebuild the cluttered high-street bank dashboard — no tile soup, upsells, or notification badges.
Don't reintroduce per-type account colours; the legacy --savings/--lisa/--business/--other/--primary/--primary-light/--success tokens are deprecated and unused.
Don't add a second accent hue, uppercase letter-spaced eyebrows, or weights above 700.
Don't put a shadow on a surface that isn't actually floating.
Don't use border-left/border-right >1px as a coloured accent stripe, or gradient text.
